Text: Times use simulation days unless marked hours. Age and moisture thresholds apply immediately. Already sampled countdowns stay unchanged; new waits use the new settings. Picking time applies when the next picking job starts. Settings apply across settlements.
Age since creation or cutting before mushrooms can grow. Default 40. Range 0-10000.
Uninterrupted irrigation required for growth. Default 8. Range 0-10000. Dry soil removes mushrooms on living trees.
Mean exponential wait after eligibility. Default 16. Zero removes this random wait. Range 0-10000. Existing countdowns are preserved.
Lower bound for a new random regrowth wait. Default 12. Range 0-10000. Raising this above the maximum also raises the maximum.
Upper bound for a new random regrowth wait. Default 20. Range 0-10000. Lowering this below the minimum also lowers the minimum. Equal bounds give a fixed delay.
Time spent picking one mushroom crop. Default 0.5 hours. Range 0.01-240. Takes effect on the next picking job.
Time an existing crop stays pickable after its tree dies. Default 2. Zero removes it immediately. Cutting always removes the crop. Changing this applies to existing dead trees.
